tasks.title: Document pure page modules and shared rendering helpers
tasks.spec: ## Repository: console — Files, proposed entry, existing-text/creation instructions, checks and completion evidence; Required behavior: The common entry and The console entry; Acceptance evidence 1-6; Non-goals, Risks and impact statements. Document reuse of src/html.ts, src/states.ts, @lorenzh/pulse-kit, test/ and test/rendered-audit.ts without changing those modules. Also implement The console entry: *-pages.ts are pure (data in, markup out, no I/O); all eight helper categories come from shared helpers, never a screen-local copy, with missing helpers added there with tests in future changes. Every page-rendering src/server.*.test.ts must run expectCalloutsOnly on the rendered body. Document these rules only; no helper extraction or test retrofit in this feature. Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Code design; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate.

acceptance.expected: prints exactly AGENTS.md; no product code, test, CI, dependency, README.md, version or generated-output changes
empty output, grep exits 1: no existing lines removed
prints 1 (at least one occurrence of the exact canonical meta URL is required)
prints exactly 200 for an unauthenticated request

Reading confirms: Add ## Code conventions directly after ## Code design; extend a section already present on current main instead of adding a duplicate. The entry names src/html.ts, src/states.ts, @lorenzh/pulse-kit, test/ and test/rendered-audit.ts; it requires searching before writing, extracting the second copy into a shared helper, and small pure functions with effects at the existing boundary. Common prose is at most three lines after the heading, and the complete console entry at most six lines of prose. It links the convention without copying its seven rules or examples, preserves all existing text and stricter rules, and adds no enforcement or refactor.

acceptance.command: for term in '*-pages.ts' 'no I/O' 'inputs' 'selects' 'choices' 'field errors' 'tables' 'callouts' 'empty states' 'outcome pages' 'src/server.*.test.ts' 'expectCalloutsOnly' 'test/rendered-audit.ts'; do grep -Fi -- "$term" AGENTS.md || exit 1; done
acceptance.expected: exit 0; all 13 literal terms occur in the Code conventions entry (case-insensitive for Inputs). Reading confirms all eight categories use shared helpers in src/html.ts and src/states.ts, a screen writes no copy, missing helpers are added there with tests when needed, and every page-rendering src/server.*.test.ts runs expectCalloutsOnly from test/rendered-audit.ts on the rendered body. This checks the documented rule, not existing code compliance.
exit 0 using the existing unchanged package.json check script; report any unrelated baseline failure as a known limit without fixing out-of-scope files
no changed or untracked path except AGENTS.md (or empty output after committing); in particular no dist/, lockfile, test or tooling changes

The PR body names the issue and supplies the AGENTS.md-only diff, link/heading grep outputs, console literal-term grep output, and the bun run check command and actual result. It records known limits, including that existing server page tests are not retrofitted (only 3 of 30 currently reference expectCalloutsOnly); states documentation-only performance impact none expected and security impact no; and leaves Acceptance evidence 6 as a post-merge feature-close check with the main SHA and repeated link/meaning/console checks, without claiming it ran before merge.

acceptance.command: verified_main_sha=$(gh api repos/lorenzh/pulse-console/commits/main --jq .sha) && printf '%s\n' "$verified_main_sha" && gh api "repos/lorenzh/pulse-console/contents/AGENTS.md?ref=$verified_main_sha" --jq .content | base64 --decode
acceptance.expected: Deferred until feature close after this target PR merges (not a pre-merge task gate): record the main commit SHA returned by GitHub and read AGENTS.md at that exact SHA. Repeat Acceptance evidence 2-3 and 4 on that content: canonical URL present at least once, exactly 1 Code conventions heading, URL HTTP 200, and the three meanings plus all 13 console literal terms and the full page/helper/test rule. This implements this target's part of Acceptance evidence 6.
